chapter: The war years: Barnet, Hot Lips Page, Newton and Kirby
title: Stalled bus on railroad tracks; Snookum Russell and King Kolax
summary: The band pushed Snookum Russell's raggedy bus off railroad tracks, and they talk of Kansas City bands.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: But getting back to the band. We then went from there to Battle Creek. We went to Kalamazoo. We played in Idaho someplace, where we stalled on railroad tracks and we heard
the train coming, and we had to push the bus! It was Snookum Russell's bus. Oh boy, Lips was so funny, man. He was an all-right guy. He just...I don't know...
Snookum Russell, where did he come from?
Kansas City. It was a raggedy bus if I ever saw one! King Kolax. You've heard of him?
Yes. He's from Chicago, isn't he.
King Kolax, and then Oliver... You've heard of Oliver, what's his name...? King Oliver.
Snookum Russell had a band of his own, and that operated out of Kansas City?
